title: JUDGE
summary: TODAYYURIST is pleased to join the group of ladies at the Young Funky School on the tour – happy vacations and memorable memories in the City of Thousand Dalais

content.text: TODAYYURIST is pleased to join the group of ladies at the Young Funky School on the tour – happy vacations and memorable memories in the City of Thousand Dalais
Discovering the Dreaming City With Fresh, Cool Climate
Visiting popular tourist points and enjoying the natural beauty of mountain streets
Check-in holds beautiful moments with colleagues and friends
Enjoy the coffee, solid, and attractive local food
Share in meaningful social activities, fun, and grouping
TODAYOURIST congratulates the ladies on their continued health, joy, and great fond memories after this journey!
